================================================================================
`enum` as a parameter name, named argument, and real enum keyword
================================================================================

def f(enum: Int): Int = enum
trait T { def g(enum: E): Unit }
enum Foo { case A, B }
val m = Map(enum = 1)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameters
      (parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier)))
    return_type: (type_identifier)
    body: (identifier))
  (trait_definition
    name: (identifier)
    body: (template_body
      (function_declaration
        name: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameters
          (parameter
            name: (identifier)
            type: (type_identifier)))
        return_type: (type_identifier))))
  (enum_definition
    name: (identifier)
    body: (enum_body
      (enum_case_definitions
        (simple_enum_case
          name: (identifier))
        (simple_enum_case
          name: (identifier)))))
  (val_definition
    pattern: (identifier)
    value: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (arguments
        (assignment_expression
          left: (identifier)
          right: (integer_literal))))))
